classification: prospective exact-wire mechanism replay after natural unseen applicability
source_selection: first naturally observed ON search output in the locked unseen task with non-empty frozen adopted bridge identifiers and a true production handler search gate
primary_question: Holding the exact captured inbound request, frozen trajectory context, scorer, router configuration, and all other production behavior fixed, does enabling only the adopted-bridge preservation floor change retained evidence?

conditions.A: frozen 89da production handler with trajectory relevance enabled, but _responses_adopted_bridge_identifiers suppressed to empty; all other trajectory context remains unchanged
conditions.D: unmodified frozen 89da production handler with trajectory relevance enabled

oracle.definition: parent-version production lines within plus/minus 5 lines of the historical source fix hunks
oracle.interpretation: historical-fix-adjacent evidence, not ground-truth causal relevance

constraints: do not select another request after seeing replay outcome
use the already-selected first natural U01-ON adopted event
condition A may suppress only adopted-floor identifiers; it must preserve the same trajectory context and all other production behavior
condition D is frozen production unchanged

interpretation.if_A_equals_D: natural adoption reproduced, but the frozen production preservation floor had no incremental effect on this exact request
interpretation.if_critical_rescue_without_regression: unseen exact-request mechanism replication of the adopted preservation floor
interpretation.if_only_noncritical_retention_changes: floor activated but no historical-critical rescue was observed
interpretation.if_regression: report the regression without replacement or tuning
